description: Standard values per heat source type (SUSI P1). Used when a house profile's heat_source sets no efficiency / fuel_price. Efficiency = seasonal performance factor (JAZ) for heat pumps, annual efficiency (Nutzungsgrad) otherwise; no age dependency.

sources.efficiency: Heat pumps luft / erde: Earnie defaults before SUSI P1 (unchanged); grundwasser and boilers: SUSI hinterlegteWerte.json, new device (Energieinstitut Vorarlberg); electric_direct: Heizrechner v5.0 Stromheizung.
sources.energy_content: SUSI hinterlegteWerte.json (oil 10 kWh/l, pellets 4,900 kWh/t, wood 1,800 kWh/rm).
sources.fuel_price: Energieinstitut Vorarlberg, Brennstoffe im Vergleich 2026 (energieinstitut.at, table of 2026-11-16; Vorarlberg household prices incl. VAT, delivered): oil 1.750 EUR/l (annual average Vorarlberg), gas 12.11 ct/kWh (VKW, current), pellets 447.73 EUR/t (proPellets Austria, 6 t, 2026-11-01, without blow-in fee). Wood: same table, 7.38 ct/kWh (155 EUR/rm at 2,100 kWh/rm, LK Vorarlberg Ofenholz exchange), converted to 1,800 kWh/rm of this file = 133 EUR/rm. District heat: not in that table; median of the 2026 vkw local heat tariff sheets, gross energy price (Arbeitspreis) of the middle tier per network: Hard 10.16, Latschau 10.96, Sulz 12.34, Schetteregg 13.75 ct/kWh (all tiers 10.0-14.5); base and metering price not included.
sources.co2_g_per_kwh: Energieinstitut Vorarlberg, Brennstoffe im Vergleich 2026 (energieinstitut.at, table of 2026-11-16, g CO2 per kWh of final energy): oil 271, gas 271, pellets 9, wood 9 (Stückholz), electricity 156 (Strom Hoch-/Niedertarif). District heat: not in that table, Hexit / Replace data.js (Energieinstitut Vorarlberg) 42.
